```{r}
# Check geometry type
st_geometry_type(sf_data)

```


```{r}
sf_polygons <- sf_data %>%
  filter(st_geometry_type(geometry) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON"))

ggplot(sf_polygons) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = MED_SL), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", na.value = "grey80") +           # plasma
  labs(
    title = "MED_SL Distribution (Polygons Only)",
    fill = "MED_SL"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
# Pretty choropleth map
p <- ggplot(sf_polygons) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = MED_SL), color = NA) +
    # geom_sf(aes(fill = MED_SL), color = "white", size = 0.01) +  # thin white borders
    scale_fill_viridis(
      option = "magma",
      # direction = -1,          # reverse for nicer contrast
      na.value = "grey90",
      name = "Median SL"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "MED_SL Distribution Across Regions",
      subtitle = "Visualizing spatial variation of MED_SL values",
      caption = "Data Source: Your GeoJSON | Visualization: ggplot2"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "#333333"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, color = "#555555"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "#777777"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "transparent"),  # remove gridlines
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )

# Save in high resolution PNG
ggsave("/Users/wenlanzhang/PycharmProjects/Netmob25_embedding/fig/MED_SL_map.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 600)

# Show map
p
```


```{r}
# Save in high resolution PNG
ggsave("MED_SL_map.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```


# Interaction
```{r}
leaflet(sf_polygons) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~colorNumeric("YlOrRd", MED_SL)(MED_SL),
    weight = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    opacity = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = ~paste("<b>", nom, "</b><br>MED_SL:", MED_SL)
  )

```
